exposure: non-classic presentation of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
Society for Pediatric Pathology (SPP) and FIGO grading categories
classic presentation of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
outcome: Distribution of classic vs. non-classic PAS presentation
cohort: 62 patients with PAS disorders who underwent gravid hysterectomy
finding: While the majority of PAS patients had classic presentation, a substantial subset (48%) did not, and scar tissue was not identified histologically in most PAS hysterectomies, suggesting that PAS cannot be fully attributed to scar dehiscence.
mod_finding: Grade 3 PAS was significantly more common in classic (72%) than non-classic (27%) presentation.
